McpServerDefinition.description: Governed Apex: list loans, get loan package, classify documents, extract and apply terms, prepare signature requests. Use Box MCP for metadata search, AI, and Doc Gen.

tools.descriptionOverride: Lists loans with loan ID, borrower, status, risk rating and amount, optionally filtered by status or borrower. Use this to answer a portfolio question, then take each loan ID to the loan package.

Finds a loan from the reference a person used, its governed Box folder, and a link to every document in the loan file. Call before asking about, extracting from, or previewing a document: the file ID is the last path segment of each link.

Extracts amount, rate, term, collateral value, LTV, DSCR and maturity date from one document of a named loan with Box AI, and returns a validation summary naming each mismatch with the record and each policy flag. Writes nothing.

Writes human-accepted loan terms to the named loan record: only the seven term fields, only the ones supplied, and only with confirmed = true after a person has accepted them. Refuses a Closed or Servicing loan. Never changes status or risk.

Creates a Box Sign request with embedded signing enabled. The embed URL is stored on the loan record for the borrower to sign in-app. Signature fields are pre-placed using Box Sign tags. Always call it rather than judging eligibility yourself; the refusal names the blocking status.

Classifies one document of a named loan with Box AI against the losDocument template and writes documentType (and policyRisk when found) to the file. A file outside that loan is refused; a document Box AI cannot name is left for a loan officer.
Approves all pending documents for a loan by updating approvalStatus from Pending to Approved.
